family.name: Influencer & Community Manager
family.summary: Pick creators for a launch from a list where the biggest account has bought followers, spend the budget for real reach, and fix a creator brief with no ad disclosure and a health claim you can’t make.

stages.title: Warm-up
stages.summary: A 45-second spontaneous answer. Not scored; gives a voice sample to compare with later recordings.

stages.title: Which creators are real value?
stages.summary: Spot bought followers (huge account, low views, foreign audience, sudden growth) and a brand-safety risk; work out real reach per rupee. Think aloud.

stages.title: Spend the budget
stages.summary: Allocate the launch budget across creators. Think aloud.

stages.title: Campaign week
stages.summary: What happens during the campaign. Tests adapting and brand safety.

stages.title: Check the creator brief
stages.summary: A creator brief with no ad disclosure, a claim you can't make and a word-for-word script. Think aloud.

stages.title: Write the creator brief (AI allowed)
stages.summary: Write a proper creator brief with AI. Catches invented claims and missing disclosure.

stages.title: A campaign or community you built
stages.summary: A real creator campaign or community effort. Checks specificity and ownership.

brief.text: You run creator partnerships at **Sleepwell**, launching a herbal sleep supplement in India next month. Budget: **₹3,00,000** for one post or reel from each creator you choose. The CEO says: "Get the biggest account you can."

brief.caption: Shortlisted creators
rows: Prank videos; two brands ended deals with him last year after a controversy
Comments are mostly emojis and "nice pic"
Followers ask her for product advice in comments
Honest wellness reviews, including negative ones

brief.text: The company and numbers are fictional, and every candidate gets a slightly different version. A calculator is fine.

prompt.text: Tell us about a brand collaboration you saw that felt fake.
Keep it under 45 seconds. This one is not scored; it just gets you talking.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

prompt.text: **Which creators give real value for this launch, and which would you avoid?** Show how you compared them.

choices.label: Put most of the budget on the one large, genuine creator
Spread it across the smaller creators with real, engaged audiences
Go with the creator with the most followers, as the CEO wants
Skip creators and run a customer video contest

prompt.text: **How do you spend the budget?** Pick one, list the creators and costs, and say how you will measure results.

material.text: Creator brief: a herbal sleep supplement

items: Read this script word for word (attached, 45 seconds).
Don't mention that it's a paid post; it should feel natural.
Post by the 15th; share your draft by the 10th.

prompt.text: Use any AI tool you like for this one. We are assessing how you use it, not whether you do.
Write the brief for creators for a herbal sleep supplement (under 200 words): what to cover, what not to say, disclosure, and what freedom they have.

items: Paste your full AI conversation, or write "none".
In 2–3 lines, say what you kept, changed or rejected from the AI and why.

Specifics such as numbers and timelines matter more than polish.
